design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1. Round 1 authored 2026-09-25; rework round 2 for audit revision 1 on 2026-09-25.
[Rework log]
  F3: the rate ladders are relabelled parameter. The honest methods are:
    - P5/P6: the held-slot anchor (counted from the latest move, the confirmation date or the booking date);
    - P7: the unpaid-balance selection rule (active plan: balance less the plan remainder; hardship approval: balance reduced by the percentage; otherwise the whole balance).
  F4: the unpaid-balance surcharge, the deposit-size credit and the payment-plan fee adjustment are removed from P5/P6. Added: the attendance escalation (multi-source over no-show and late-cancellation ledger charges), the hardship reduction (approved percentage when it covers the visit date, half when it ended within 90 days) and the account-age courtesy credit. P7 drops its account-age credit to keep its drawn count of 4.
  F1/F2 have no consequence here (no cancellation, rebooking or reschedule is written; P5/P6/P7 windows already ended on NOW).
  World: the CT was moved once by the patient on 2026-07-12, with a 35.00 balance collected that day, so it now holds 425.00. The consult's first-move balance is split 20.00 card + 15.00 HSA; its latest move was 2026-09-12 to 2026-09-25, held 275.00. A 20 percent hardship approval runs through 2026-12-31.
  Gold: 174.00 / 25.00 / 425.00.
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 -> prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[6, 6, 4]. Taken as: no-show prohibition 6, missed-visit refund 6, moved-visit balance 4.
[Scope] {no_show_fee_prohibition, moved_visit_deposit_balance (owner=user), missed_visit_deposit_refund}, with their three tools; disjoint from task 0.
[Why a good test] The customer says only that he missed his 2026-09-15 CT and wants the deposit back. The refund rule sends the agent to two waits:
  (a) The no-show fee decision. Medicaid has been effective since 2026-07-01, so the fee is prohibited, for a six-factor amount. It reads the ledger (with a virtual-visit fee as the near-miss), the held-slot days counted from the patient's move, the confirmation date, the account age and the hardship approval covering the visit date.
  (b) His moved consult holds no deposit entry after its 2026-09-12 move, so he pays a four-factor balance first. Its balance selection subtracts the balance remaining on his active plan.
[Problem tree card] Root: missed_visit_deposit_refund. Order: prohibition -> balance -> refund (the first two commute).
  Edge 1: -> no_show_fee_prohibition. value_input, gate no_show_fee_recorded_as_waived. Sentence: 'The deposit refund on a missed visit is fixed only after the missed visit's fee and deposit history shows the decision on its no-show fee.' False at the opening: 82be1c9a-c94a-4c7f-b1af-62770538d92b has three collections only. The only writer is P5's tool.
  Edge 2: -> moved_visit_deposit_balance. state_gate. Sentence (negated): 'A deposit on a missed visit is not refunded until each open visit the patient moved shows a deposit entry dated on or after that visit's latest move.' False at the opening: 62fbdc74-3472-46b7-b3dc-6e1d753e3455 was last moved 2026-09-12, and its latest entries are dated 2026-07-06. The only writer is P7's user tool.
  Deletion sensitivity: skipping the prohibition makes the refund 251.00; skipping the payment leaves the refund 425.00, but the 25.00 entry is missing.
[Factor card] (tier taken -> figure when that factor alone is set to baseline)
  P5: escalation, one kind only (multi-source) -> 144.00; held-slot anchor from the move (method) -> 182.00; held 60-89 days -> 162.00; confirmed within 2 days -> 154.00; courtesy 730-1825 days -> 182.00; hardship covering the date -> 217.50. All-baseline figure: 150.00. Gold: 174.00.
  P7: rate x1.5 -> 0.00; move lead <14 days -> 0.00; balance selection with an active plan (method, payplan) -> 50.00; balance amount 40 -> 0.00. All-baseline figure: 0.00. Gold: 25.00.
  P6 (same tiers as P5): 455.00 / 437.00 / 417.00 / 445.00 / 417.00 / 381.50; all-baseline 449.00. Gold: 425.00.
  Historical deposits obey the charter:
    - CT 390.00 at booking, +35.00 at the move (required 425.00);
    - consult 240.00 at booking, +35.00 at its 2026-07-06 move (required 275.00);
    - the 2026-09-12 move requires 300.00 (225 + 50 + 25, active plan);
    - that second move was timely under P1 (11 counted notice days against 6 required).
[Base-invariant card]
  fee_waived: the gates are superseded; applies_to_event_id is empty (no billing trigger).
  deposit_collected: one_deposit is superseded by P7.
  deposit_released: policy_scope.
  Medicaid on the scheduled date: 2026-07-01 <= 2026-09-15. No time gate.
[Business-object card] The refund is on 82be1c9a-c94a-4c7f-b1af-62770538d92b over e50ac613-d8b8-4fad-a7cd-972b55f49c97, 15414f4f-723b-419b-b624-757bb930db73 and a6b9f594-f76a-4603-9315-4d96fc3848af. The balance is on 62fbdc74-3472-46b7-b3dc-6e1d753e3455 over 824d4672-5384-4428-9cc6-6f36c143007f, c23e65ca-d144-4f91-9ed1-16e82457c0dc, 3ee8c9ce-c5a3-48b3-b326-87e8fd9f8c2d and ecfe87a8-b2b2-40de-8ca2-ff7945b95584. Excluded: 57ace786-9b38-48d2-af13-e974420addb5; the ledger rows and the plan feed only counts and balances.
[Persona] Tobias is calm and embarrassed and volunteers only the surface request. He gives phone, DOB and SSN4 when asked; his insurance, plan and hardship approval only when asked. He mentions the consult only if asked, pays the balance only after the agent explains it, and hangs up once the refund amount is confirmed.
[Standard solution] Locate and verify (DOB + SSN4). Read the appointments, events, account, ledger and plan. Record the prohibition for 174.00. Hand over the balance payment of 25.00. Refund 425.00.
[Verification] sens.py: 174.0 (144.0 / 162.0 / 182.0 / 154.0 / 182.0 / 217.5; all 150.0); 25.0 (0.0 / 0.0 / 50.0 / 0.0; all 0.0); 425.0 (455.0 / 437.0 / 417.0 / 445.0 / 417.0 / 381.5; all 449.0). Edge skips: 251.0 and 425.0.
[Draft recomputation from visible context]
  Prohibition: (150 x 1.25 + 15 + 25 - 10) x 0.8 = 174.00.
  Balance: 150 x 1.5 + 50 + 25 = 300, against 275 held, gives 25.00.
  Refund: 425 - 174 + 174 = 425.00.
[Known observation] O-SC: the refund equals the deposit held when the agent's waiver and offset agree; the discrimination sits in the prohibition amount.
user_scenario: You are Tobias Carver, 51, a warehouse night-shift lead from Westerville, calling Linden Ridge's Patient Services Center in the afternoon; you are calm, a bit embarrassed, and you speak in plain, short sentences. On Tuesday, September 15 you slept through your 8:30 CT scan at the Westerville clinic after a double shift; you had moved that scan once in July and confirmed it by text two days before, and nobody has called you about missing it. When you booked the scan in June you paid a deposit, part on your regular card and part on your HSA card, and a little more when you moved it; it came to around four hundred dollars all told, and you don't know the exact figures. What you want from this call is that deposit back, since the scan never happened. You open with: "I missed my CT scan on the 15th and I'd like to get back the deposit I paid for it." You give details only when the agent asks: your phone number is 6145551836, your date of birth is November 2, 1974 (1974-11-02), and the last four of your Social Security number are 1482. If the agent asks about insurance, you say you have been on Medicaid through Scioto Valley Health Plan since July 1st and paid for yourself for a while before that. If the agent asks whether you have a payment plan, you say yes, a three-month plan you signed in August, and you made the first payment on September 20. If the agent asks about financial help, you say the billing office approved you for a hardship discount earlier this year. If the agent mentions a missed-appointment fee, you ask only whether you will owe anything and accept what the agent says the record shows. You also have a lung-doctor visit with Dr. Idowu that you moved twice yourself, most recently on September 12, to Friday, September 25; you bring it up only if the agent asks about your other appointments, and you have not paid anything on it since July. Only if the agent explains that a deposit balance on that September 25 visit has to be paid before your CT deposit can be refunded do you agree to pay it yourself by card; when the agent hands the payment over to you, you pay exactly the amount the agent tells you on that September 25 visit and read back the receipt number if asked. You do not want to rebook the scan on this call and you ask for nothing beyond the refund. If a figure the agent gives does not match what you remember, you just ask them to check it against your records; you never suggest a number or a step yourself. Once the agent tells you the CT deposit refund has gone through and for how much, you thank them and hang up.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The fee prohibition (on the CT) and the balance payment (on the consult) are parallel prerequisites. They write different appointments. The prohibition's compute reads only the CT and the account; the balance's compute reads only the consult, the account and the plan. Row ids hash their own arguments. Either order gives the same terminal hash and the same 174.00 / 25.00 (sens.py). Both precede the refund.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the waiver entry the refund recomputes to 251.00 instead of 425.00 (sens.py skip run).

Skipping the payment leaves the refund at 425.00, but the terminal state lacks the 25.00 collection on the consult (deposit_held_usd stays 275.00), and the refund would be made while the rule says it is not yet due.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only for the CT deposit back. It never names the no-show fee decision, the Medicaid prohibition or a balance on the September 25 visit. That visit is mentioned only if the agent asks about his other appointments, and he pays only after the agent explains the balance is owed first. No policy id appears.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: refund_missed_visit_deposit_4264223f only reads the appointment to copy encounter and deposit held, then writes the refund. record_no_show_fee_prohibition_783ac881 writes the waiver whatever the visit's status. pay_deposit_balance_07a1fa0e writes the collection whatever the visit's history. None returns an Error for an unmet prerequisite.
